subject: microbiology
title: Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Melioidosis, Acinetobacter and Other Non-Fermenters

steps.tx: **Pseudomonas aeruginosa** is an aerobic non fermenting gram negative rod (oxidase positive) painting cultures blue green with **pyocyanin** and fluorescing **fluorescein (pyoverdine)** under ultraviolet, smelling of grapes or tortillas, thriving in water and moist hospital corners, intrinsically armed with efflux, porin control and AmpC against casual antibiotics.
steps.say: Blue green pigment, grape smell, water loving: Pseudomonas announces itself twice.

vis.caption: Pseudomonas and Burkholderia pathogenesis in lung and burn infections.

steps.tx: **Burn wound infection** is Pseudomonas theatre: colonised eschar turns to invasive sepsis with green discharge and ecthyma, **ecthyma gangrenosum** (painless round ulcers with black centres and red halos) in neutropenic bacteraemia even without burns, folliculitis from hot tubs in the well. Skin signs announce the rod before cultures.
steps.say: Black centred painless ulcers in neutropenia mean Pseudomonas in blood until excluded.

left.title: Skin signals
points: Toe web and otitis externa swimmer forms

right.title: Deep theatres
points: Malignant otitis externa diabetics skull base

steps.tx: **Cystic fibrosis Pseudomonas** adapts over years: mucoid alginate biofilm colonies, quorum sensing, hypermutators and antibiotic tolerance in bronchiectasis, inhaled tobramycin and aztreonam and eradication at first isolation, chronic infection defining prognosis. The same species in CF is a biography, not an episode.
steps.say: First Pseudomonas in CF gets eradication therapy; chronic mucoid gets inhaled suppression.

left.title: Adaptation
points: Biofilm and anaerobic niches in plugs

right.title: CF practice
points: Early eradication inhaled plus oral traditions

steps.tx: **Pseudomonas virulence kit**: type III secretion injecting ExoU (necrotising pneumonia worst) and ExoS, exotoxin A (EF2 ADP ribosylation like diphtheria), proteases and phospholipases melting cornea in contact lens keratitis, pyocyanin oxidative injury, flagella and pili adhesion. Contact lens overnight wear plus Pseudomonas can perforate a cornea in days.
steps.say: Painful red eye in a lens wearer is Pseudomonas keratitis until a specialist says otherwise.

left.title: Secretion toxins
points: LasA and LasB elastases tissue and immune cleavage

right.title: Surface factors
points: Type IV pili twitch and attach

steps.tx: **Therapy for Pseudomonas** demands susceptibility guided anti pseudomonal beta lactams (piperacillin tazobactam, cefepime, ceftazidime, meropenem) often combined initially in shock, newer beta lactam inhibitor pairs for resistant (ceftolozane tazobactam, ceftazidime avibactam, imipenem relebactam, cefiderocol), aminoglycoside never alone deep, source control sovereign.
steps.say: Name your anti pseudomonal beta lactam out loud; regular ceftriaxone does not count.

left.title: Classical agents
points: Aztreonam (allergy niches, MBL stable alone logic)

steps.tx: **Burkholderia pseudomallei** causes **melioidosis** in wet season tropics (northern Australia, southeast Asia): soil and water percutaneous and inhaled, bipolar **safety pin** gram stain, diabetes terrain, pneumonia and abscesses everywhere including prostate and spleen, bipolar staining, intrinsically resistant gentamicin and colistin (selective Ashdown medium exploits), ceftazidime or meropenem intensive then months eradication co trimoxazole.
steps.say: Diabetic rice farmer, rainy season, abscesses everywhere: melioidosis until excluded.

left.title: Melioidosis portrait
points: Pneumonia, liver spleen and prostate abscesses

right.title: Bench and therapy
points: Ashdown selective, wrinkled colonies, earthy smell (do not sniff)

steps.tx: **Burkholderia mallei** causes **glanders** in equids and occupational human infection (ulcers, lymphangitis farcy, pneumonia), largely eradicated where equine control holds, bioterror listing; cepacia complex colonises CF lungs and contaminated products with patient to patient history, infection control separating cepacia cohorts.
steps.say: Glanders follows horses, cepacia follows CF clinics and contaminated bottles.

steps.tx: **Acinetobacter baumannii** is the desiccation surviving ICU coccobacillus (oxidase negative non fermenter) colonising ventilators and wounds, carbapenem resistance (OXA enzymes) global, therapy sulbactam based (ampicillin sulbactam high dose, sulbactam durlobactam), colistin and tigecycline debates, environmental cleaning deciding outbreaks.
steps.say: Dry surfaces keep Acinetobacter alive between patients; sulbactam is its surprising weakness.

left.title: Baumannii portrait
points: Ventilator pneumonia, lines, wounds war associated

steps.tx: **Stenotrophomonas maltophilia** (water, ventilators, lines in immunocompromised) carries chromosomal metallo beta lactamase making carbapenems intrinsically useless, co trimoxazole anchor (levofloxacin, minocycline), while **non fermenter bench sorting** (oxidase, motility, oxidation of sugars, pigment) separates the whole tribe from Enterobacterales fermenters.
steps.say: Carbapenem resistant by birth: Stenotrophomonas takes co trimoxazole, not meropenem escalation.

left.title: Stenotrophomonas
points: L1 metallo and L2 enzymes built in
